PROJECT GENESIS & DECISION MATRIX

The Classroom Bottleneck in Higher Education

Chosen through a rigorous 9-factor evaluation matrix (Qayd 38/45 vs Poetry Trainer 36/45)

01

Cognitive Overload Dilemma

التشتت الذهني الحاد بين الفهم والتدوين

Students sacrifice over 70% of mental bandwidth struggling to frantically transcribe board code and equations rather than deeply internalizing core engineering concepts.

Consequence: Hasty incomplete notes with zero analytical retention.
02

Bilingual Code-Switching Gap

ازدواجية الشرح والمصطلحات التقنية

In CS classrooms, professors explain conversational logic in Arabic while technical terms (Traverse, Pointers, Memory Leaks, Big-O) are strictly English. Standard cloud speech-to-text fails on mixed utterances.

Consequence: Garbled terminology or erroneous phonetic spelling.
03

The 60-Min Audio Black Box

مقبرة التسجيلات الصوتية غير القابلة للبحث

Students record 50-minute raw audio memos, yet finding a 30-second doctor explanation before an exam requires scrubbing through gigabytes of unindexed files.

Consequence: Audio files are abandoned; exam preparation remains inefficient.
Genesis Evaluation: Qayd won 38/45 vs 36/45 (Poetry Recitation Trainer) on feasibility, market size, and technical utility.

PILLAR 01 SPECIFICATION: DUAL AUDIO SUBSYSTEM

AudioRecordingService & AudioCompressionService

Live recordings are captured directly as 44.1 kHz mono AAC at 64 kbps (~28 MB/hour) via an Android Foreground Service. External audio files (MP3, M4A, WAV, AAC, OGG, WEBM, FLAC) are compressed locally using FFmpeg to 16 kHz mono 32 kbps MP3, guarded by a strict 100 MB post-compression size gate.

Post-Compression Limit 100 MB Cap

TASK 02: SPEECH PROCESSING (ISSUE #3)

Whisper on Groq & The Translation Trap Resolution

تفريغ فائق السرعة وحل مشكلة ترجمة الكلمات الإنجليزية للعربية

Groq LPUs • Whisper-large-v3

When given instruction prompts (e.g. "Transcribe verbatim without translation"), Whisper interpreted the prompt as preceding transcript context, echoing prompt tokens or translating spoken English to Arabic (Issue #3). We solved this in commit f7657f6:

01. Acoustic Auto-Detection
Omitted Language Parameter

By leaving language unspecified by default, Whisper dynamically identifies Arabic, English, or mixed code-switching per segment.

02. Pure Lexical Glossary
Instruction-Free Prompt

Replaced instruction prose with a clean CS vocabulary list (API, thread, process, cache, CPU), priming spelling without prompt echo.

03. 15x–20x LPU Speed
Groq Inference Engine

A 45-minute lecture chunk transcribes in ~70 seconds (~1.8s per segment), delivering immediate note generation.

04. Sub-Second Timestamps
Seekable Segments

Captures exact start and end timestamps [MM:SS] for each sentence, enabling bidirectional Tap-to-Seek audio sync.

Code-Switching Auto-Detection Verified Commit f7657f6

AUTOMATED VALIDATION SHIELD

The 4-Layer Anti-Hallucination Shield

درع مكافحة الهلوسة الصوتية بأربع طبقات أمان صارمة

6 Unit Tests Passing
LAYER 01: Acoustic Confidence Check
Silence & Log-Probability Gate

Discards hallucinated segments where no_speech_prob > 0.6 and avg_logprob < -1.0.

LAYER 02: Compression Ratio Check
Infinite Repetition Loop Breaker

Discards low-entropy repetitive hallucination loops where compression_ratio > 2.4.

LAYER 03: Phantom Credit Blocklist
Phantom Caption & Echo Purge

Strips known phantom credits ('نانسي قنقر', 'اشترك في القناة', 'Amara.org') and echoes of the glossary prompt.

LAYER 04: Consecutive Deduplication
Duplicate Segment Suppression

Suppresses identical consecutive segments generated when audio input lacks vocal change.

TASK 04: GOOGLE GEMINI 3 FLASH (ISSUE #6)

Structured AI Synthesis with Instant Bilingual Toggle

التلخيص بالذكاء الاصطناعي مع التبديل اللغوي الفوري

📋

Executive Lecture Summary

The lecture covered advanced Graph Data Structures, contrasting Adjacency Matrix vs. Adjacency List representations, and rigorously analyzing BFS and DFS algorithms for shortest-path traversal.

🗂️

Topic Breakdown & Deep Dive

  • Graph Representation: Adjacency Matrix provides O(1) edge lookup but incurs O(V²) memory.
  • Adjacency List achieves optimal O(V + E) memory space for sparse networks.
  • Practical network routing applications and state-space search mechanics.
⭐

Key Exam Takeaways

  • BFS time complexity is strictly O(V + E) using an adjacency list.
  • Dijkstra algorithm fails catastrophically on graphs with negative edge weights.
  • Min-Heap / Priority Queue reduces Dijkstra complexity down to O(E log V).
📖

Glossary of Key Technical Terms

Adjacency List Array of lists tracking adjacent vertices for each node.
Time Complexity Computational order of growth quantifying asymptotic execution time.

UI HARDENING: ISSUE #1 & 39PX FIX

Eliminating Overflow Defects Across All Viewports

معالجة أخطاء الشاشات المدمجة وضمان صفر بكسل تجاوز

0-Pixel Overflow Guaranteed

Two Documented Layout Challenges

01. Issue #1: ProcessingScreen 120px Overflow (Commit ae504f4)

Multi-line Gemini errors (e.g. 402 credits depleted) overflowed the fixed column by 120px, pushing recovery buttons off-screen. Resolved by wrapping in SingleChildScrollView with maxLines: 4 ellipsis.

02. DetailScreen: 39px Language Row Overflow

In English mode, the language selector row overflowed by 39px on compact Android displays. Resolved via Expanded label wrapping, VisualDensity.compact, and compact horizontal padding.

TASK 05: ACADEMIC ARCHIVAL

Publication-Grade Vector PDF Export with Arabic Ligature Un-Reversing

توليد مستندات PDF متجهة مطبوعة خالية من تشويه الحروف العربية

Standard PDF libraries flip Arabic characters backwards in mixed BiDi lines (rendering "قَيْد" as "دْقيَ"). We engineered a custom in-app shaping pipeline delivering print-ready A4 study sheets.

Unicode Presentation Forms-B Un-Reversing

Tashkeel is stripped, glyphs are shaped into Presentation Forms-B (0xFE70–0xFEFF), and internal word characters are un-reversed to restore forward cursive connectivity.

Embedded Google Cairo Vector Typography

Embeds clean academic vector fonts for crystal-clear readability on physical paper and tablets.

LOCAL-FIRST DATA ARCHITECTURE

Hive Storage & Transcript-First Invariant

JSON-map key-value boxes ensuring zero data loss and sub-10ms queries

📦

Local-First Hive Boxes

صناديق Hive بدون Adapters مولدة

Stores Qayd, QaydFolder, TranscriptSegment, and QaydSummary models as clean JSON maps with 100% offline access.

🛡️

Transcript-First Invariant

حفظ التفريغ أولاً قبل التلخيص

Critical Reliability Rule: The transcript is committed to disk BEFORE requesting LLM summarization. If network drops or quotas deplete, the student never loses their recording or transcript.

📁

Folders & Full-Text Search

مجلدات المقررات والبحث اللحظي

Single-level subject folders (e.g. CS442, CS311) with multi-criteria real-time filtering across titles, audio transcripts, and key terms in milliseconds.

Management Capabilities: Rename • Move to Folder • Export to PDF • Safe Deletion Hive Local-First • Sub-10ms Queries
